answer: The juniper index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the nadir queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 495 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the copper. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
